text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THAWRA - President Saddam Hussein receives groups of children on the Moslem feast of Eid al-Fitr.
- Large delegation of French businessmen to visit Iraq soon.
- Zionist warplanes destroy more Palestinian houses.
- Minister of health receives Belgian peace activists.
- Calls for the release of Iraq's frozen assets abroad.
- United Nations completes preparations for the distribution of food supplies in the Kurdish provinces of Dahouk and Arbil.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary lambasts U.S. and allies for the bombing of al- Amiriya shelter in Baghdad during the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait
- Commentary criticises attempts to delay arrival of food and medicine to Iraq under an oil-for-food deal with U.N.
